# The deployment itself

Activity, administration, and what the deployment reports about itself.

## activity

### `GET /api/activity`

Query the activity log with combinable filters + pagination.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_id` | query | no | `string` | Filter: activity for a specific entity (UUID). |
| `actor_id` | query | no | `string` | Filter: activity by a specific user (UUID). |
| `action` | query | no | `string` | Filter: activity by action type. |
| `since` | query | no | `string` | Filter: activity at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_ActivityEntry`](schemas.md#listenvelope-activityentry) | Page of activity entries, newest first |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Malformed filter value |

## admin

### `GET /api/admin/tenants`

List provisioned tenants. Deployment-admin only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_TenantSummary`](schemas.md#listenvelope-tenantsummary) | Page of tenants |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Caller is not a deployment admin |

### `POST /api/admin/tenants`

Create a tenant: T-0008 provisioning (org row, schema, migrations,
defaults, boards) PLUS the initial org-admin membership, in one
transaction. Deployment-admin only.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateTenantRequest`](schemas.md#createtenantrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`TenantCreatedResponse`](schemas.md#tenantcreatedresponse) | Provisioned; initial_admin reports the seeded org admin |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Caller is not a deployment admin |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Tenant already exists |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Invalid slug, or the initial admin has never logged in |

### `DELETE /api/admin/tenants/{slug}`

Drop a tenant: removes the `org_{slug}` schema (CASCADE) and the
organization row. Destructive and unrecoverable — requires
`?confirm=true` (422 `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` otherwise). Deployment-admin
only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Tenant slug |
| `confirm` | query | no | `boolean` | Must be `true` to actually drop the tenant. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`TenantDeletedResponse`](schemas.md#tenantdeletedresponse) | Dropped |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Caller is not a deployment admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown tenant |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED (missing ?confirm=true) |

Doc-stub for `POST /api/auth/token` (KAIROS-T-0039): the handler lives
in [`crate::web`]. PUBLIC (pre-login by nature): the same-origin relay
to the issuer's token endpoint for the SPA's PKCE code exchange and
refresh grant (IdP token endpoints rarely serve CORS).

Request body: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, —

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | — | The issuer's token response, passed through |
| `400` | — | The issuer rejected the grant (OAuth error JSON, passed through) |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unsupported grant_type or missing field |
| `502` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | The configured issuer is unreachable |

### `GET /api/config`

Doc-stub for `GET /api/config` (KAIROS-T-0039): the handler lives in
[`crate::web`]. PUBLIC (no auth): it is the SPA's discovery endpoint —
exactly the information a login page needs before any token exists.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | — | SPA login configuration (public): `{issuer, client_id, authorization_endpoint, api_bearer}` — the deployment issuer, the GUI's OAuth client id (KAIROS_WEB_CLIENT_ID), the issuer's authorization endpoint from OIDC discovery, and which token the SPA sends as the `/api` bearer (`access_token` default, or `id_token` for opaque-access-token issuers like Google Workspace, KAIROS-T-0054) |
| `502` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | The configured issuer is unreachable |
